segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Acme Telecom. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I am furious! My internet has been cutting out all morning and I work from home!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I completely understand how frustrating that is. Let me pull up your modem telemetry right away.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I see an upstream noise lock on your node. I just pushed a signal reset to your router now.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hold on... the light just turned green and my connection is back up. Wow, that was actually fast.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Great! The ping latency is back to normal. Is there anything else I can take care of for you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No, that was everything. Thank you so much Alex, I really appreciate the quick fix. Have a great day.

ground_truth.reason: Agent reset the router signal resolving the outage; customer calmed down and expressed gratitude.

evidence.quote: I just pushed a signal reset to your router now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Customer Care, this is Sarah. How may I assist you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hello Sarah, good morning. I was wondering if I could please get an extension on my rebate coupon that expired yesterday?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good morning! Let me check our promotion policy for that voucher code... I am so sorry, but the promotional system hard-locks expired coupons.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Ah, I understand. I know it is not your fault at all Sarah, rules are rules. Thank you so much for checking for me anyway.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I truly wish I could override it. Thank you for being so gracious and understanding.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No worries at all, you have a wonderful afternoon. Bye-bye.

ground_truth.reason: Customer politely requested coupon extension which company policy strictly prohibited.

evidence.quote: the promotional system hard-locks expired coupons.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Billing support, my name is Mark. How can I assist you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: You charged me a bogus fifty dollar late fee on card 4532 0151 1283 0366! This is utter extortion!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I apologize for the confusion. Let me review your payment history right away.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I see your payment cleared on the due date. I have reversed and refunded the fifty dollar fee to your account right now.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Well you should never have stolen it in the first place! Your company always pulls this shady garbage, I am sick of having to call every single month!

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Do not thank me for calling. I am still furious that your billing system is so broken. Goodbye.

ground_truth.reason: Late fee was refunded immediately, but customer remained furious about recurring billing errors.

evidence.quote: I have reversed and refunded the fifty dollar fee to your account right now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello, Tech Support, this is Dave.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh fantastic, another automated update that completely crashed my server. Just wonderful job by your engineering team.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am very sorry about that update crash. Which package version was applied?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Version 4.2. Truly a masterpiece of software design. Can you roll it back or do I stare at a brick all day?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, I am executing the rollback command to version 4.1 now... and your instance is healthy again.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Well miracles do happen. It is finally back. Don't push broken patches again.

ground_truth.reason: Customer used heavy sarcasm over server outage, which agent resolved by rolling back the software version.

evidence.quote: executing the rollback command to version 4.1 now... and your instance is healthy again.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Global Logistics, Kevin speaking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Where is my package? The tracking has not moved in four days!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: If you could provide your tracking—

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I already typed it into the phone tree! Why do I have to repeat it?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The IVR did not forward—

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Tracking number is 987654321! Check it!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you. It cleared customs this morning and is out on the local delivery van right now for delivery by 3 PM.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay. Fine. As long as it gets here today.

ground_truth.reason: Customer repeatedly interrupted agent before receiving confirmation package is on delivery truck today.

evidence.quote: out on the local delivery van right now for delivery by 3 PM.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Premier Banking support, how can I help?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Can you waive my annual credit card fee this year?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I checked your account profile, but your tier is not eligible for fee waivers this cycle.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thanks for checking anyway, I appreciate your honesty. I guess I will cancel the card next week.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Understood. Please let us know if there is anything else we can assist you with.

ground_truth.reason: Customer thanked the agent for checking, but the fee waiver request was denied.

evidence.quote: your tier is not eligible for fee waivers this cycle.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Account Services, Brian speaking. How may I help?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: You cancelled my flight without sending me an email notification! I need to be rebooked immediately!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The next available flight is tomorrow evening, and there is a change fare of two hundred dollars.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Are you out of your mind?! You cancelled my flight, I am not paying a dime! Escalate this to a supervisor right now!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I cannot waive the airline fee myself. Let me place you on hold and transfer you to a supervisor queue.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Get them on the line immediately. This is outrageous.

ground_truth.reason: Agent could not waive airline change fee, prompting angry customer to demand supervisor escalation.

evidence.quote: Escalate this to a supervisor right now!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yeah, what's your problem?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Excuse me? I was calling to check why my mobile data plan was throttled.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Because you used all your gigabytes obviously. Read your contract.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That is extremely rude and unprofessional. I have an unlimited plan!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Whatever. It slows down after 20 gigs. Nothing I can do.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I am filing a formal complaint against you.

ground_truth.reason: Agent was dismissive and disrespectful toward customer question regarding data throttling.

evidence.quote: Because you used all your gigabytes obviously. Read your contract.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling QuickMart, this is Elena.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Elena, just wanted to check if order 123456 has shipped?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Let me see... yes, it shipped this morning via FedEx tracking 5550192834.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Wonderful, that is all I needed. Thank you so much for the quick help!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You are very welcome! Have a wonderful day.

ground_truth.reason: Agent promptly provided tracking details for customer order.

evidence.quote: yes, it shipped this morning via FedEx tracking 5550192834.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Metro Power emergency dispatch, officer Higgins.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi, there is a sparking line near Elm Street, wait can you hear me? The signal is—

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello? Caller, which cross street on Elm?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Near the... [static] ...hello? Can you hear—

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Call disconnected.

ground_truth.reason: Call disconnected abruptly due to static before the incident location could be confirmed.

evidence.quote: Call disconnected.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: IT Helpdesk, Jordan speaking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi, I locked myself out of the intranet portal again.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: No problem Jordan, I have reset your account password and sent a temporary link to your registered email.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Got the email and I am logged in now. Perfect, thanks!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Glad to assist, enjoy your day.

ground_truth.reason: Agent reset portal access and customer successfully logged in.

evidence.quote: I have reset your account password and sent a temporary link

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Appliance Warranty, this is Chloe.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: My blender motor started smoking after two months and I want a replacement unit under warranty.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Looking at your serial number, water ingress damage is explicitly excluded from warranty coverage.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: It is a kitchen appliance, how can water exclude warranty?! That makes zero sense, you guys are scammers!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I apologize, but that is the manufacturer term. I cannot authorize a free replacement.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I will make sure everyone knows never to buy your junk.

ground_truth.reason: Warranty claim denied due to water ingress exclusion, angering customer.

evidence.quote: I cannot authorize a free replacement.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: StreamPlus billing, how can I assist?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi, I would like to cancel my streaming subscription please.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I can take care of that for you right now. Your auto-renewal is cancelled and access ends at the billing cycle.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thank you, that was very simple and hassle-free.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You are welcome. We hope to see you back in the future.

ground_truth.reason: Agent cleanly processed subscription cancellation without friction.

evidence.quote: I can take care of that for you right now. Your auto-renewal is cancelled

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Glassware Direct, support team.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: My package arrived with shattered champagne flutes! Glass is everywhere, this is unacceptable!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Oh no, I am so sorry to hear that. Please be careful with the shards. I am dispatching a complimentary replacement set via priority shipping right now.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh... really? Without me having to ship back broken glass?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, absolutely. You do not need to return damaged glass. The tracking number is already sent to your email.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That is wonderful customer service. Thank you so much for fixing it immediately.

ground_truth.reason: Agent replaced shattered order immediately with expedited shipping and no return hassle.

evidence.quote: I am dispatching a complimentary replacement set via priority shipping right now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Personal Loans department, Eric speaking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi, I have a question about my commercial mortgage refinance rate.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Ah, you have reached personal consumer loans. I will need to transfer you to our commercial lending team.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, please transfer me over.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Transferring now.

ground_truth.reason: Caller reached wrong department and had to be transferred.

evidence.quote: I will need to transfer you to our commercial lending team.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Fraud prevention desk, Officer Vance.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I see an unfamiliar transaction for four hundred dollars from an overseas merchant on my card.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I have frozen the card to prevent further charges and opened a formal investigation claim #789123.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Will I get my money back today or what?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The fraud review takes up to five business days. We will notify you once the investigation concludes.

ground_truth.reason: Card frozen and claim opened, but refund decision is pending a 5-day fraud review.

evidence.quote: The fraud review takes up to five business days.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Member Services, this is Lisa.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Lisa, I just moved and need to update my mailing address.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Sure thing! What is the new address?... Got it, your address is updated across all accounts.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That was super quick! Thank you so much.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: My pleasure, have a wonderful moving day!

ground_truth.reason: Agent updated member mailing address smoothly.

evidence.quote: your address is updated across all accounts.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Cloud Database support, Sam speaking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Our production database cluster is completely unresponsive! Can you restart it?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Unfortunately our internal management console is currently down due to an active regional outage. Nothing I can do until engineering recovers the control plane.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: We are losing thousands of dollars every minute! This is a disaster!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand and apologize, but our entire team is blocked right now.

ground_truth.reason: Internal management console was down during regional outage, preventing any immediate remediation.

evidence.quote: Nothing I can do until engineering recovers the control plane.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Skyline Airways, how may I help you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hello, I booked a non-refundable economy ticket for tomorrow, but my doctor advised against traveling.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am so sorry to hear about your health. Basic economy fares do not permit cash refunds under airline tariff rules, though I can offer travel credit minus a fifty dollar fee.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I understand policies are strict. I won't be able to travel within the year so the credit won't help, but thank you for your kind tone anyway.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I truly wish you a speedy recovery. Take care.

ground_truth.reason: Customer politely requested non-refundable ticket exception which policy prohibited.

evidence.quote: Basic economy fares do not permit cash refunds under airline tariff rules

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: SolarTech Loyalty desk, Maria speaking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Maria! I love your solar panel system, it cut our electric bill in half! Just calling to redeem my reward points for a smart thermostat.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is so wonderful to hear! I just processed the thermostat reward redemption; it will ship out tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Awesome! You guys are the best. Thank you Maria!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you for being our loyal customer!

ground_truth.reason: Enthusiastic customer successfully redeemed loyalty points for a smart thermostat.

evidence.quote: I just processed the thermostat reward redemption; it will ship out tomorrow morning.
